"""Catalogue the creator's own background-music folder ("New BG Music").

    uv run python learning/bgmusic_catalog.py            ->  learning/bgmusic_catalog.json  +  learning/BGMUSIC.md

Per track: duration, tempo, loudness, energy curve (1 s), spectral brightness, and KEY MOMENTS found from the audio itself:
  intro_end   when the track first reaches its normal energy      drops      sudden energy rises (the hit you want on a cut)
  breaks      quiet gaps / breakdowns                             climax     loudest 10 s
  outro_start where the track starts to wind down (use for the final scene)
Mood tags come from the features plus what the track is known for; copyright notes follow the creator's policy
(copyrighted clips are fine as short stings only; Kevin MacLeod / Jason Shaw / Broke for Free need a credit).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SRC = HERE.parent.parent / "New BG Music"
SR = 22050

SKIP = ("How_to_Find",)
# what each track is known for (title -> tags, credit/copyright note). Features refine the rest.
KNOWN = {
    "Sneaky Snitch": (["sneaky", "stealth", "comedic", "quirky"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Sneaky Adventure": (["sneaky", "playful"], "unknown source"),
    "Sneaky Business": (["sneaky", "comedic"], "Biz Baz Studio"),
    "Sneaky Snooper": (["sneaky", "playful", "short"], "Jason Shaw, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Up to Something": (["sneaky", "playful"], "unknown source"),
    "Scheming Weasel": (["sneaky", "comedic", "fast"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Hidden Agenda": (["tense", "stealth", "dark"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Hitman": (["tense", "stealth", "dark"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Investigations": (["tense", "mysterious"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "High Tension": (["tense", "suspense", "build"], "Jason Shaw, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Ghostpocalypse": (["action", "tense", "chaos"], "Kevin MacLeod-style action"),
    "In the Hall of the Mountain King": (["chase", "escalating", "panic", "classic"], "public domain composition"),
    "Pursuit": (["chase", "dramatic", "action", "short"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Strategy": (["dramatic", "build", "short"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Powerful Massive And Dramatic": (["epic", "dramatic", "orchestral", "finale"], "check licence"),
    "Marty Gots a Plan": (["upbeat", "quirky", "playful"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Monkeys Spinning Monkeys": (["comedic", "playful", "bouncy"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Fluffing a Duck": (["comedic", "playful", "bouncy"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy": (["playful", "light", "comedic"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Divertissement Pizzicato": (["comedic", "plucky", "light"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Elevator Music": (["awkward", "comedic", "calm"], "Kevin MacLeod, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Spanish Flea": (["comedic", "upbeat"], "COPYRIGHTED (Herb Alpert): short sting only"),
    "Curb Your Enthusiasm": (["awkward", "meme", "short"], "COPYRIGHTED: short sting only"),
    "Spongebob": (["comedic", "meme"], "COPYRIGHTED: short sting only"),
    "Star Wars Cantina": (["comedic", "quirky"], "COPYRIGHTED: short sting only"),
    "Mario Kart": (["hype", "meme", "short"], "COPYRIGHTED: short sting only"),
    "Wii Music": (["comedic", "nostalgic", "calm"], "COPYRIGHTED: short sting only"),
    "Wii Shop": (["comedic", "nostalgic", "calm"], "COPYRIGHTED: short sting only"),
    "Sad Emotional Piano": (["sad", "emotional", "slow"], "YouTube library style"),
    "Sleigh Bells": (["trap", "festive", "meme"], "remix: only as a gag"),
    "Cinema Sins": (["comedic", "playful"], "unknown source"),
    "Add And": (["upbeat", "chill", "cooking-show"], "Broke for Free, CC-BY: credit"),
    "Brain Trust": (["comedic", "light", "quirky"], "Wayne Jones, no copyright"),
    "Cartoon Music": (["comedic", "cartoon", "bouncy"], "Mattia Cupelli"),
    "Gaiety in the Golden Age": (["comedic", "old-timey", "light"], "Aaron Kenny"),
    "The Curious Kitten": (["comedic", "plucky", "light"], "Aaron Kenny"),
    "Workaday World": (["comedic", "light", "calm"], "unknown source"),
    "TipToes": (["comedic", "sneaky", "plucky"], "Myuu"),
    "Pizzicato Playtime": (["comedic", "plucky", "light"], "unknown source"),
    "Laureate": (["gaming", "calm", "short"], "unknown source"),
    "Lynn Music Boulangerie": (["light", "cafe", "calm"], "unknown source"),
    "Retrofuture": (["upbeat", "retro", "electronic"], "Kevin MacLeod-style"),
    "Everybody": (["upbeat", "electro-swing", "hype"], "Dutty Moonshine"),
    "Dutty Moonshine": (["upbeat", "electro-swing", "hype"], "Dutty Moonshine"),
    "Darix Togni": (["upbeat", "dance", "hype"], "unknown source"),
    "Mighty Fine": (["upbeat", "bluesy", "fun"], "Otis McDonald, YouTube library"),
    "Not For Nothing": (["upbeat", "fun"], "Otis McDonald, YouTube library"),
    "Otis McMusic": (["upbeat", "fun"], "Otis McDonald, YouTube library"),
    "Scarlet Fire": (["tense", "driving"], "Otis McDonald, YouTube library"),
    "It Takes Two to Tango": (["comedic", "dramatic", "latin"], "unknown source"),
    "Minoru": (["upbeat", "electronic"], "unknown source"),
    "Hej": (["quirky", "playful"], "Rysk, royalty free"),
}


def decode(path: Path) -> np.ndarray:
    r = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-i", str(path), "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(SR), "-f", "s16le", "-"],
                       capture_output=True)
    return np.frombuffer(r.stdout, dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768.0


def analyse(path_s: str) -> dict:
    path = Path(path_s)
    x = decode(path)
    if len(x) < SR * 2:
        return {"file": path.name, "error": "too short"}
    dur = len(x) / SR
    # ---- 1 s energy curve (dB)
    n = SR
    frames = x[: len(x) // n * n].reshape(-1, n)
    rms = np.sqrt((frames ** 2).mean(1)) + 1e-9
    db = 20 * np.log10(rms)
    med = float(np.median(db))
    sm = np.convolve(db, np.ones(3) / 3, "same")
    # ---- tempo from the onset envelope
    hop, win = 512, 1024
    nf = (len(x) - win) // hop
    idx = np.arange(win)[None, :] + hop * np.arange(nf)[:, None]
    S = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x[idx] * np.hanning(win), axis=1))
    flux = np.maximum(0, np.diff(np.log1p(S * 10), axis=0)).sum(1)
    fr = SR / hop
    ac = np.correlate(flux - flux.mean(), flux - flux.mean(), "full")[len(flux) - 1:]
    lo, hi = int(fr * 60 / 180), int(fr * 60 / 60)
    lag = lo + int(np.argmax(ac[lo:hi]))
    bpm = float(60 * fr / lag)
    while bpm < 80:
        bpm *= 2
    while bpm > 170:
        bpm /= 2
    # ---- brightness
    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(win, 1 / SR)
    cen = float((S.mean(0) * freqs).sum() / (S.mean(0).sum() + 1e-9))
    # ---- key moments
    drops, breaks = [], []
    for t in range(3, len(sm) - 3):
        rise = sm[t + 2] - sm[t - 2]
        if rise >= 5.0 and (not drops or t - drops[-1] > 8):
            drops.append(t)
    quiet = sm < med - 7
    t = 0
    while t < len(quiet):
        if quiet[t]:
            j = t
            while j + 1 < len(quiet) and quiet[j + 1]:
                j += 1
            if j - t + 1 >= 3 and t > 4 and j < len(quiet) - 6:
                breaks.append([t, j + 1])
            t = j + 1
        else:
            t += 1
    thr = med - 4
    intro_end = int(next((t for t in range(len(sm)) if sm[t] >= thr), 0))
    outro_start = int(next((t for t in range(len(sm) - 1, -1, -1) if sm[t] >= thr), len(sm) - 1))
    w10 = np.convolve(db, np.ones(10) / 10, "valid")
    climax = int(np.argmax(w10)) if len(w10) else 0
    energy = float(np.mean(db))
    dyn = float(np.std(db))
    # ---- mood from features + known
    name = re.sub(r"_", " ", path.stem)
    title = re.split(r"\s+-\s+", re.sub(r"\(HD\)", "", name))[0].strip()
    tags, note = [], ""
    for k, (tg, nt) in KNOWN.items():
        if k.lower() in name.lower():
            tags, note = list(tg), nt
            break
    if not tags:
        tags = ["upbeat"] if bpm > 110 else ["calm"]
    if energy > -17 and bpm > 120 and "upbeat" not in tags and "action" not in tags:
        tags.append("energetic")
    return {
        "file": path.name, "path": str(path), "title": title, "duration_s": round(dur, 1), "bpm": round(bpm),
        "loudness_db": round(energy, 1), "dynamics_db": round(dyn, 1), "brightness_hz": round(cen),
        "tags": tags, "note": note,
        "intro_end_s": intro_end, "outro_start_s": outro_start, "climax_s": climax,
        "drops_s": drops[:6], "breaks_s": breaks[:4],
        "energy_curve_db": [round(float(v), 1) for v in sm[:: max(1, len(sm) // 90)]],
    }


def main():
    files = sorted(p for p in SRC.glob("*.mp3") if not any(s in p.name for s in SKIP))
    files += sorted(p for p in SRC.glob("*.wav"))
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(6) as ex:
        rows = list(ex.map(analyse, [str(p) for p in files]))
    rows = [r for r in rows if "error" not in r]

"""Music plan for rd-full from the creator's own library (studio/learning/bgmusic_catalog.json).

Every scene of the video gets a track chosen for its mood; montages start on a track's detected DROP so the hit lands on the
first break; sad / defeat scenes use the piano; the dragon fight gets the dramatic orchestral finale. Loudness is normalised
per track (catalog loudness) so a loud electro-swing and a quiet pizzicato both sit the same under the voice.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CAT = {r["title"].lower(): r for r in json.loads((HERE.parent.parent / "learning" / "bgmusic_catalog.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))}


def track(name: str) -> dict | None:
    name = name.lower()
    return next((r for k, r in CAT.items() if name in k), None)


# (substring of the scene note / tag, track, role)   first match wins.  role: "drop" = start so the drop lands on the cut,
# "start" = from the top, "outro" = end the track on the scene end
RULES = [
    ("COLD", "everybody", "drop"),
    ("intro (final take)", "cartoon music", "start"),
    ("first blocks", "pizzicato playtime", "start"),
    ("inventory full", "pizzicato playtime", "start"),
    ("speed through", "minoru", "drop"),

    ("moment of truth", "scheming weasel", "start"),
    ("go ham", "minoru", "drop"),
    ("GO HAM", "minoru", "drop"),
    ("so defeated", "sad emotional piano", "start"),
    ("chaos four", "ghostpocalypse", "drop"),
    ("spawn-trapped", "ghostpocalypse", "start"),
    ("destroyed", "sad emotional piano", "start"),

    ("reset the chaos", "high tension", "start"),

    ("sponsor", "add and", "start"),
    ("chaos meter back", "marty gots a plan", "start"),
    ("game plan", "marty gots a plan", "start"),
    ("new strategy", "marty gots a plan", "start"),
    ("keep one of each", "marty gots a plan", "start"),
    ("skeleton, spider", "scarlet fire", "start"),

    ("mining for TNT", "scarlet fire", "start"),
    ("500 more blocks", "dutty moonshine", "start"),
    ("I give up", "sad emotional piano", "start"),
]
FALLBACK = {"fun": "otis mcmusic", "tense": "high tension", "epic": "darix togni", "sad": "sad emotional piano",
            "dragon": "powerful massive"}


def pick(note: str, bed: str) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    for key, name, role in RULES:
        if key.lower() in (note or "").lower():
            t = track(name)
            if t:
                return t, role
    return track(FALLBACK.get(bed, "otis mcmusic")), "start"


def offset_for(t: dict, role: str, section_len: float) -> float:
    if role == "drop" and t.get("drops_s"):
        d = [x for x in t["drops_s"] if x > 4]
        if d:
            return max(0.0, d[0] - 0.4)
    if role == "drop" and t.get("intro_end_s", 0) > 0:
        return float(t["intro_end_s"])
    return 0.0


def volume_for(t: dict, role: str, is_montage: bool) -> float:
    """dB trim so every track lands at the same level under the voice (the renderer's file fallback is -20 dB)."""
    v = -14.0 - t["loudness_db"]
    v = max(-9.0, min(12.0, v))
    if is_montage:
        v += 4.0                       # no voice there: music up
    return round(v, 1)

content.text:
I've sent seven new test clips. I haven't rendered the full video yet, and the drone and replay shots are still out of the cut on purpose, as you suggested.

## Your notes, and what I did
- **Context and clips that don't make sense:**
  - I stopped scenes starting mid-sentence and removed orphan fragments such as "actually one thing that…".
  - I added the missing setup lines, for example the lightning and mobs before the spear, and "I think I found a boat" before the boat.
  - Each scene now plays through to the end of its sentence.
- **Voice cut off and bad takes:**
  - Voice endings are longer, and the cut waits for the sentence to finish.
  - Repeated takes are detected and dropped automatically. The joke repeats ("oh no no no", "we're good x5") are kept.
- **Grass montage:** nothing sits over it now. The clip with something on top came from the old automatic extras. I've turned those off, and I also removed the automatic farts that were being added.
- **Music:** the video now draws from your New BG Music folder. It uses 24 different songs, one per scene mood, and montage songs start on their drop.
- **Icons:** they now land when the word is actually heard, a little after the speech-recognition timestamp. The dirt fart lands there too.
- **Screams:** I added a gentle second compressor and a soft ceiling on your voice. Screams come down a bit, but it isn't flattened to talking level.
- **TNT and go-ham montages:** they now mix 4× sped-up mining with the break-synced moments.
- **Green screens:**
  - John Cena ("Are you sure about that?") lands on "moment of truth" with a freeze frame and a black-and-white strip.
  - The Rock ("biggest piece of dog shit") lands on the rage with the same freeze treatment.
  - The others are all different: Steve Carell "no god please no", Jon Bernthal "no no no", CJ "here we go again", Westbrook "what?", and Street Fighter KO.
- **Memes and edits:** 37 memes, green screens and icon pops across 23.6 minutes. That's about 1.6 per minute.

## Your music folder
52 tracks are catalogued, with tempo, loudness, drops, breaks and climax, in `studio/learning/BGMUSIC.md` (and `.json`). The zip only contained three tracks that were already in the folder. The copyrighted ones (Spongebob, Cantina, Mario Kart, Wii, Curb, Spanish Flea) are tagged as short stings only, and I haven't used them as beds. The credits needed for the Kevin MacLeod and Jason Shaw tracks are in `projects/rd-full/CREDITS.txt`.

## Honest caveats
- **Drone and replay shots:** I've pulled them out for now, so the cut is clean. You were right that they need the locked cut first. Once you approve it, I'll plan each shot for a specific moment (longer, varied, with a purpose) and splice them in. The old ones were templated and pointless.
- **I can't hear the music choices:** the picks are based on each track's measured feel plus what I know about it. Tell me which clips or songs feel wrong and I'll swap them.
- **Clip peak level:** one clip measured a little loud on peaks. I'll lower the ceiling for the final render.
- **Dark stretches:** the End and caves are dark in the footage itself. If you'd like a light brightness lift only on the very dark moments, say so. It wouldn't be a colour filter.

input.content:
"""Make the 'TNT in every chunk' transition: a snake-order wall of TNT blocks pops onto the screen (2.4 s), fully covering the frame,
plus one pre-mixed rising 'pop' sound track.   Writes overlays/tnt_wall.mov (ProRes 4444 + alpha) and overlays/tnt_pops.wav"""
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
import wave
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STUDIO = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(STUDIO))
from mcstudio import assets as A  # noqa: E402

W, H, FPS = 1920, 1080, 30
COLS, SIZE = 12, 160
ROWS = 7
DUR = 2.5
REVEAL = 2.05            # all blocks placed by here, then the wall holds
N = COLS * ROWS


def order():
    out = []
    for r in range(ROWS):
        cols = range(COLS) if r % 2 == 0 else range(COLS - 1, -1, -1)       # snake: left->right, then right->left, ...
        out += [(r, c) for c in cols]
    return out


def main():
    a = A.get("image.tnt")
    src = STUDIO.parent / (a.get("root") or "Editing Pack") / a["path"]
    base = Image.open(src).convert("RGBA")
    pos = order()
    t_in = [0.05 + REVEAL * i / (N - 1) for i in range(N)]
    cache: dict[int, Image.Image] = {}

    def icon(sz):
        if sz not in cache:
            cache[sz] = base.resize((sz, sz), Image.NEAREST)
        return cache[sz]

    out = HERE / "overlays" / "tnt_wall.mov"
    out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p = subprocess.Popen(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgba", "-s", f"{W}x{H}", "-r", str(FPS), "-i", "-",
                          "-c:v", "prores_ks", "-profile:v", "4444", "-pix_fmt", "yuva444p10le", str(out)], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
    for f in range(int(DUR * FPS)):
        t = f / FPS
        frame = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        for i, (r, c) in enumerate(pos):
            dt = t - t_in[i]
            if dt < 0:
                continue
            k = min(1.0, dt / 0.16)
            sc = 1.0 + 0.22 * np.sin(k * np.pi) if k < 1 else 1.0          # pop: 0 -> 1.2 -> 1
            sz = max(2, int(SIZE * (min(1.0, dt / 0.08)) * sc))
            ic = icon(sz)
            x = c * SIZE + (SIZE - sz) // 2
            y = r * SIZE + (SIZE - sz) // 2
            frame.alpha_composite(ic, (x, y))
        p.stdin.write(frame.tobytes())
    p.stdin.close()
    p.wait()
    # ---- one pre-mixed pop track: pitch rises along the snake
    pa = A.get("sfx_ui.pop")
    ps = STUDIO.parent / (pa.get("root") or "Editing Pack") / pa["path"]
    r = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-i", str(ps), "-t", "0.25", "-f", "s16le", "-ac", "1", "-ar", "48000", "-"], capture_output=True)
    pop = np.frombuffer(r.stdout, dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768
    buf = np.zeros(int((DUR + 0.5) * 48000), dtype=np.float32)
    for i, t0 in enumerate(t_in):
        rate = 1.0 + 0.9 * i / N                                              # pitch up
        idx = np.arange(0, len(pop) - 1, rate)
        s = np.interp(idx, np.arange(len(pop)), pop) * (0.55 + 0.35 * i / N)
        s *= np.linspace(1, 0.2, len(s))

content.text:
I've sent five fixed test clips.

## What changed
- **The Rock:**
  - The creative-mode rage window is gone entirely.
  - The Rock now hits at "this world is the definition of cancer" in part 2, in survival footage, with the freeze and colour strip.
  - Captions censor f-words and the other strong swears with stars. Your audio was already bleeped, but the text was showing them.
- **Music under your voice:**
  - I had set quiet songs too loud.
  - Every track is now levelled against your processed voice. Talking scenes sit about 19 dB under your voice and the voice-less montages about 12 dB under.
  - Clip 5 is a plain talking stretch (the chaos meter explanation), so you can judge it.
- **Bad takes before the TNT idea:**
  - It now starts at your final take, "I've probably died about nine times…".
  - The "Okay. So I, okay. So at this point…" takes are cut.
  - The repeat finder is also tighter in general.
- **TNT transition:**
  - A snake-order wall of TNT pops onto the screen in 2.5 seconds, with rising pop sounds, and fully covers the frame at the cut.
  - It runs from the end of the "TNT in every chunk" line into the next scene.
- **Deaths:**
  - **Early montage:** six real death screens from the swarm and mob deaths. Each is about 1.7 seconds, with "DEATH #1…#6" and the game's own death sounds.
  - **Dragon montage:** five dragon deaths right after "died six, probably seven times". Clips with creative-mode frames are shortened or skipped.
- **Sad cloud:** removed, and I took out the other W/L badge too.
- **Ending:** the video now freezes on the exact frame you hit the ground, the instant before the red death screen. The sad violin plays there, then the end card.
- **Green screens:** the two Nice repeats are fixed. Each green screen is now a different one.

## Things to know
- **Fewer death screens than expected:** I only detected death screens in parts 1 and 3. Part 2 had basically none, and a few were in creative-mode stretches I skip. Tell me if you remember any deaths I'm missing and where they happened.
- **The Enderman line you mentioned:** I couldn't find a scene break matching "finding Enderman" in the transcript. The abrupt cut was the jump into the "Okay. So I…" take, which is fixed now. If the Enderman moment is somewhere else, give me a timestamp in the clips and I'll look.

I'll keep polishing from your notes. Once you approve the cut I'll plan the proper replay and drone shots against it.

def hook_text(edl: dict, segs: list[dict], pj: dict, n: int) -> str:
    """A hook must promise the payoff. First short: the episode title; others: a strong on-screen line
    from inside the window, else a tease matched to how the window ends."""
    title = (pj.get("title") or "").upper()
    if n == 1 and title:
        return title[:34] + ("..." if not title.endswith(("!", "?", "...")) else "")
    ids = {s["id"] for s in segs}
    texts = [t["text"] for t in edl.get("text", []) if t.get("seg") in ids and len(t["text"]) <= 22
             and t.get("style") != "label" and not BORING.search(t["text"])]
    if texts:
        return texts[0]
    end_mode = segs[-1].get("mode") or edl.get("mode", "funny")
    return TEASES.get(end_mode, TEASES["funny"])


def make_short(slug: str, n: int, win: dict, edl: dict, pj: dict) -> str:
    main_segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    segs = [dict(s) for s in main_segs[win["from"]: win["to"] + 1]]
    ids = {s["id"] for s in segs}
    keep = lambda e: e.get("seg") in ids or ("src_at" in e and "seg" not in e and "at" not in e)  # noqa: E731
    skip_text = {"label"}                                # intro titles / speed labels stay in the long video
    texts = [dict(t) for t in edl.get("text", []) if keep(t)
             and not (t.get("style") in skip_text and "SPEED" not in t["text"])
             and not re.search(r"EARLIER|LATER", t["text"], re.I)]      # cold-open segues mean nothing in a short
    hook = win.get("hook") or hook_text(edl, segs, pj, n)
    hook_overlay = {"type": "motion", "template": "hook_banner", "vars": {"text": hook}, "seg": segs[0]["id"],
                    "rel": 0.0, "dur": 3.2}
    from . import settings as SET                          # [settings] shorts.hook_banner / template switches
    use_hook = SET.template_ok(SET.load(slug), "hook_banner")
    # [cinematic] replay B-roll is 16:9 full-frame: render would stretch it into 9:16, so shorts leave it out
    overlays = [dict(o) for o in edl.get("overlays", []) if keep(o) and o.get("type") != "transition"
                and not o.get("cinematic")
                and o.get("template") not in ("title_card", "subscribe", "time_card", "end_screen")]
    if use_hook:
        overlays.insert(0, hook_overlay)
    for o in overlays:                                    # corner overlays read better centred on a phone
        if o.get("x") is not None and o.get("placement") != "fullscreen":
            o["x"], o["scale"] = 0.5, min(0.32, o.get("scale", 0.45))
    sfx = [dict(e) for e in edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []) if keep(e) and not e.get("cinematic")
           and not (e.get("rel") is not None and e.get("rel") <= 0 and "rewind" in e.get("asset", ""))]

    # music: whatever bed was playing where the short starts, re-timed into the short
    spans_main = build_spans(edl, lambda i: A.get(i))
    start_out = next(sp.out_start for sp in spans_main if sp.seg_id == segs[0]["id"])
    total = sum(seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i)) for s in segs)
    music = []
    for m in edl.get("audio", {}).get("music", []):
        at = resolve_time(m, spans_main, [], "music") if ("at" in m or "src_at" in m or "seg" in m) else 0.0
        until = m.get("until", 1e9)
        if at is not None and at <= start_out < until:
            music.append({**{k: v for k, v in m.items() if k not in ("at", "until", "src_at", "seg")},
                          "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "in": round(m.get("in", 0) + start_out - at, 2),
                          "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})
            break
    if not music and edl.get("audio", {}).get("music"):
        m = edl["audio"]["music"][0]
        music.append({"asset": m["asset"], "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})

    short = {"version": 1, "project": f"{slug}--short-{n}", "title": hook, "format": "vertical",
             "mode": edl.get("mode", "funny"), "parent": slug, "segments": segs, "overlays": overlays,
             "text": texts, "audio": {"sfx": sfx, "bleeps": [b for b in edl.get("audio", {}).get("bleeps", [])
                                                         if keep(b)], "music": music},
             "captions": {**edl.get("captions", {}), "hide": []}}
    if edl.get("watermark"):
        short["watermark"] = edl["watermark"]
    if edl.get("facecam"):
        short["facecam"] = {**edl["facecam"], "layout": "stack"}

    sslug = f"{slug}--short-{n}"
    dst = PROJECTS / sslug
    (dst / "work").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = project_dir(slug)
    spj = dict(pj)
    for k, s in spj.get("sources", {}).items():           # absolutise relative source paths
        if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("file") and not Path(s["file"]).is_absolute():
            s["file"] = str((src / s["file"]).resolve())
    spj.update({"slug": sslug, "title": hook, "kind": "short", "parent": slug})
    (dst / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(spj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for f in ("transcript.json", "transcript.md", "signals.json", "levels.json"):
        if (src / "work" / f).exists():
            shutil.copy2(src / "work" / f, dst / "work" / f)
    (dst / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps(short, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[shorts] {sslug}: {len(segs)} segments, {total:.1f}s, hook {hook!r}")
    return sslug

    """A hook must promise the payoff. First short: the episode title; others: a strong on-screen line
    from inside the window, else a tease matched to how the window ends."""
    title = (pj.get("title") or "").upper()
    if n == 1 and title:
        return title[:34] + ("..." if not title.endswith(("!", "?", "...")) else "")
    ids = {s["id"] for s in segs}
    texts = [t["text"] for t in edl.get("text", []) if t.get("seg") in ids and len(t["text"]) <= 22
             and t.get("style") != "label" and not BORING.search(t["text"])]
    if texts:
        return texts[0]
    end_mode = segs[-1].get("mode") or edl.get("mode", "funny")
    return TEASES.get(end_mode, TEASES["funny"])


def make_short(slug: str, n: int, win: dict, edl: dict, pj: dict) -> str:
    main_segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    segs = [dict(s) for s in main_segs[win["from"]: win["to"] + 1]]
    ids = {s["id"] for s in segs}
    keep = lambda e: e.get("seg") in ids or ("src_at" in e and "seg" not in e and "at" not in e)  # noqa: E731
    skip_text = {"label"}                                # intro titles / speed labels stay in the long video
    texts = [dict(t) for t in edl.get("text", []) if keep(t)
             and not (t.get("style") in skip_text and "SPEED" not in t["text"])
             and not re.search(r"EARLIER|LATER", t["text"], re.I)]      # cold-open segues mean nothing in a short
    hook = win.get("hook") or hook_text(edl, segs, pj, n)
    hook_overlay = {"type": "motion", "template": "hook_banner", "vars": {"text": hook}, "seg": segs[0]["id"],
                    "rel": 0.0, "dur": 3.2}
    from . import settings as SET                          # [settings] shorts.hook_banner / template switches
    use_hook = SET.template_ok(SET.load(slug), "hook_banner")
    # [cinematic] replay B-roll is 16:9 full-frame: render would stretch it into 9:16, so shorts leave it out
    overlays = [dict(o) for o in edl.get("overlays", []) if keep(o) and o.get("type") != "transition"
                and not o.get("cinematic")
                and o.get("template") not in ("title_card", "subscribe", "time_card", "end_screen")]
    if use_hook:
        overlays.insert(0, hook_overlay)
    for o in overlays:                                    # corner overlays read better centred on a phone
        if o.get("x") is not None and o.get("placement") != "fullscreen":
            o["x"], o["scale"] = 0.5, min(0.32, o.get("scale", 0.45))
    sfx = [dict(e) for e in edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []) if keep(e) and not e.get("cinematic")
           and not (e.get("rel") is not None and e.get("rel") <= 0 and "rewind" in e.get("asset", ""))]

    # music: whatever bed was playing where the short starts, re-timed into the short
    spans_main = build_spans(edl, lambda i: A.get(i))
    start_out = next(sp.out_start for sp in spans_main if sp.seg_id == segs[0]["id"])
    total = sum(seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i)) for s in segs)
    music = []
    for m in edl.get("audio", {}).get("music", []):
        at = resolve_time(m, spans_main, [], "music") if ("at" in m or "src_at" in m or "seg" in m) else 0.0
        until = m.get("until", 1e9)
        if at is not None and at <= start_out < until:
            music.append({**{k: v for k, v in m.items() if k not in ("at", "until", "src_at", "seg")},
                          "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "in": round(m.get("in", 0) + start_out - at, 2),
                          "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})
            break
    if not music and edl.get("audio", {}).get("music"):
        m = edl["audio"]["music"][0]
        music.append({"asset": m["asset"], "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})

    short = {"version": 1, "project": f"{slug}--short-{n}", "title": hook, "format": "vertical",
             "mode": edl.get("mode", "funny"), "parent": slug, "segments": segs, "overlays": overlays,
             "text": texts, "audio": {"sfx": sfx, "bleeps": [b for b in edl.get("audio", {}).get("bleeps", [])
                                                         if keep(b)], "music": music},
             "captions": {**edl.get("captions", {}), "hide": []}}
    if edl.get("watermark"):
        short["watermark"] = edl["watermark"]
    if edl.get("facecam"):
        short["facecam"] = {**edl["facecam"], "layout": "stack"}

    sslug = f"{slug}--short-{n}"
    dst = PROJECTS / sslug
    (dst / "work").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = project_dir(slug)
    spj = dict(pj)
    for k, s in spj.get("sources", {}).items():           # absolutise relative source paths
        if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("file") and not Path(s["file"]).is_absolute():
            s["file"] = str((src / s["file"]).resolve())
    spj.update({"slug": sslug, "title": hook, "kind": "short", "parent": slug})
    (dst / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(spj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for f in ("transcript.json", "transcript.md", "signals.json", "levels.json"):
        if (src / "work" / f).exists():
            shutil.copy2(src / "work" / f, dst / "work" / f)
    (dst / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps(short, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[shorts] {sslug}: {len(segs)} segments, {total:.1f}s, hook {hook!r}")
    return sslug

"""Generate Flashback (Moulberry) editor-state / keyframes for automatic cinematic B-roll.

Everything here mirrors what the decompiled mod (v0.39.10, MC 1.21.11) reads and writes:

* ``.minecraft/flashback/editor_states/<replay uuid>.json``  <- ``EditorState`` serialised with
  ``FlashbackGson.COMPRESSED`` (Gson). The file name is the ``uuid`` from the replay's metadata.json.
  ``Flashback.openReplayWorld`` calls ``EditorStateManager.get(uuid)`` which loads it, so writing this
  file *before* the replay is opened is how keyframes are injected without touching the GUI.
* Timeline unit = **replay ticks (20/s)**; keyframes live in ``scene.keyframeTracks[i].keyframesByTick``
  keyed by tick-as-string. One scene == one shot (own tracks + own export range).
* Camera conventions (verified from ``KeyframeChangeCameraPosition*`` / ``KeyframeChangeTrackEntity``):
    - ``camera`` keyframe ``position`` is the *feet* position of the camera entity; the eye is +1.62.
    - ``camera_orbit``: camera eye = center - look(yaw,pitch) * distance, facing (yaw,pitch).
      ``center`` is the world point to look at (use eye height of the subject).
    - MC angles: yaw 0 = +Z (south), 90 = -X (west); pitch +90 = straight down.

Public API
----------
Shot templates (all return a :class:`Shot`):  ``orbit``, ``drone_pullup``, ``push_in``, ``flyby``,
``track_follow``, ``timelapse``.   Build a document with :func:`build_state`, validate with
:func:`validate_state`, write with :func:`write_state`, plan automatically with :func:`auto_shots`.

"""Generate Flashback (Moulberry) editor-state / keyframes for automatic cinematic B-roll.

Everything here mirrors what the decompiled mod (v0.39.10, MC 1.21.11) reads and writes:

* ``.minecraft/flashback/editor_states/<replay uuid>.json``  <- ``EditorState`` serialised with
  ``FlashbackGson.COMPRESSED`` (Gson). The file name is the ``uuid`` from the replay's metadata.json.
  ``Flashback.openReplayWorld`` calls ``EditorStateManager.get(uuid)`` which loads it, so writing this
  file *before* the replay is opened is how keyframes are injected without touching the GUI.
* Timeline unit = **replay ticks (20/s)**; keyframes live in ``scene.keyframeTracks[i].keyframesByTick``
  keyed by tick-as-string. One scene == one shot (own tracks + own export range).
* Camera conventions (verified from ``KeyframeChangeCameraPosition*`` / ``KeyframeChangeTrackEntity``):
    - ``camera`` keyframe ``position`` is the *feet* position of the camera entity; the eye is +1.62.
    - ``camera_orbit``: camera eye = center - look(yaw,pitch) * distance, facing (yaw,pitch).
      ``center`` is the world point to look at (use eye height of the subject).
    - MC angles: yaw 0 = +Z (south), 90 = -X (west); pitch +90 = straight down.

----------
Shot templates (all return a :class:`Shot`):  ``orbit``, ``drone_pullup``, ``push_in``, ``flyby``,
``track_follow``, ``timelapse``.   Build a document with :func:`build_state`, validate with
:func:`validate_state`, write with :func:`write_state`, plan automatically with :func:`auto_shots`.

CLI demo:  python -m mcstudio.flashback_keyframes <replay.zip> [--out DIR]

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- cinematic interface
    @staticmethod
    def _replay_uuid(replay: Path) -> str:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(replay) as z:
            return str(json.loads(z.read("metadata.json").decode("utf-8"))["uuid"])

    @staticmethod
    def _codec(name: str | None) -> str:
        return {"h264": "H264", "h265": "H265", "hevc": "H265", "av1": "AV1", "vp9": "VP9"}.get(str(name or "h264").lower(), "H264")

    def _shot_for_job(self, job: dict, scene: int) -> dict:
        ex = job["export"]
        rng = (job.get("camera", {}).get("keyframes") or {}).get("export_range_ticks") or [job.get("tick_start"), job.get("tick_end")]
        start, end = (rng + [None, None])[:2]
        vis = job.get("visuals", {})
        return {"scene": scene, "name": re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.@-]+", "_", job["job_id"] + "_" + str(job.get("shot_id", ""))),
                "start": start, "end": end, "output": str(Path(ex["output_abs"])), "width": int(ex["width"]),
                "height": int(ex["height"]), "fps": float(ex["fps"]), "container": "MP4", "codec": self._codec(ex.get("codec")),
                "encoder": None, "bitrate": int(ex.get("bitrate", 20_000_000)), "ssaa": False, "noGui": bool(vis.get("hide_gui", True)),
                "resetRng": False, "recordAudio": False, "transparent": False, "kind": job.get("kind", ""), "note": job["job_id"]}

    def render_batch(self, jobs: list[dict]) -> list[Result]:
        """Export several cinematic jobs of the SAME replay in one game launch (one scene per job)."""
        if not jobs:
            return []
        replays = {j["replay"]["path"] for j in jobs}
        if len(replays) != 1 or not next(iter(replays)):
            raise FlashbackAutoError("render_batch needs jobs that all reference the same replay path")
        replay = Path(replays.pop())
        project = jobs[0]["project"]
        run_dir = JOBS_DIR / project / f"run-{jobs[0]['job_id']}-x{len(jobs)}"
        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        # one editor state with one scene per job
        states, shots = [], []
        for i, j in enumerate(jobs):
            kf = (j.get("camera") or {}).get("keyframes")
            if not kf or kf.get("errors") or not kf.get("editor_state"):
                raise FlashbackAutoError(f"{j['job_id']}: no valid camera keyframes (editor_state) in the job; re-run queue "
                                         "with the replay available")
            states.append(kf["editor_state"])
            shots.append(self._shot_for_job(j, i))
        state = json.loads(json.dumps(states[0]))
        state["scenes"] = [st["scenes"][0] for st in states]
        state["sceneIndex"] = 0
        job_file = run_dir / "jobs.json"
        job_file.write_text(json.dumps({"version": 1, "replay": str(replay), "jobs": shots}, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        if not self.launch:
            return self.export(job_file, launch=False)

        from mcstudio import flashback_keyframes as FK
        errs = FK.validate_state(state)
        if errs:
            raise FlashbackAutoError("invalid editor state: " + "; ".join(errs[:3]))
        ed = self.mc_dir / "flashback" / "editor_states"
        target = ed / f"{self._replay_uuid(replay)}.json"
        backup = target.with_name(target.name + ".flashback_auto_backup")
        existed = target.exists()
        if existed and not backup.exists():
            shutil.copy2(target, backup)
        ed.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(FK.dumps_state(state), encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            return self.export(job_file, launch=True)
        finally:
            if existed:
                shutil.copy2(backup, target)       # put the creator's own editor state back
                backup.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            else:
                target.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    def render(self, job: dict) -> Path | None:
        """Exporter interface of mcstudio.cinematic: Path of the clip, None when it will arrive later (dry run), raises on failure."""
        out = Path(job["export"]["output_abs"])
        res = self.render_batch([job])[0]
        if res.ok:
            return out
        if res.message.startswith("dry run"):
            return None
        raise FlashbackAutoError(f"{job['job_id']}: {res.message}")

def orbit(target, start: int, seconds: float = 6.0, radius: float = 6.0, height: float = 2.0,
          revolutions: float = 1.0, direction: int = 1, start_angle: float | None = None,
          center_offset=(0.0, 1.2, 0.0), ease: str = "inout", samples_per_s: float = 4.0,
          name: str | None = None) -> Shot:
    """Camera circles the (moving) target, always looking at it. One CAMERA_ORBIT track.

    radius = horizontal distance, height = camera height above the look-at point.
    ``start_angle`` = camera look yaw at the start (default: target's facing -> camera behind it).
    direction +1 = clockwise seen from above. Yaw is NOT wrapped (orbit interpolation is plain linear/CatmullRom
    on the number, so 360*n works)."""
    tg = as_target(target)
    ticks, total = _ticks(start, seconds, samples_per_s)
    e = _ease(ease)
    d = math.hypot(radius, height)
    pitch = math.degrees(math.atan2(height, radius))
    y0 = tg.rot(start)[0] if start_angle is None else start_angle
    kfs = {}
    n = len(ticks) - 1
    for i, t in enumerate(ticks):
        u = e(i / n)
        px, py, pz = tg.pos(t)
        c = (px + center_offset[0], py + center_offset[1], pz + center_offset[2])
        kfs[t] = orbit_kf(c, d, y0 + direction * 360.0 * revolutions * u, pitch)
    return Shot(name or f"orbit@{start}", "orbit", start, ticks[-1], [Track("CAMERA_ORBIT", kfs)],
                f"orbit r={radius} h={height} rev={revolutions}", dict(radius=radius, height=height))


def drone_pullup(target, start: int, seconds: float = 5.0, start_dist: float = 3.5, end_dist: float = 45.0,
                 start_pitch: float = 8.0, end_pitch: float = 68.0, yaw_drift: float = 35.0,
                 start_angle: float | None = None, center_offset=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), ease: str = "inout",
                 samples_per_s: float = 5.0, name: str | None = None) -> Shot:
    """Camera starts low and close behind the target and rises/backs away while tilting down (reveal shot)."""
    tg = as_target(target)
    ticks, total = _ticks(start, seconds, samples_per_s)
    e = _ease(ease)
    y0 = tg.rot(start)[0] if start_angle is None else start_angle
    n = len(ticks) - 1
    kfs = {}
    for i, t in enumerate(ticks):
        u = e(i / n)
        px, py, pz = tg.pos(t)
        c = (px + center_offset[0], py + center_offset[1], pz + center_offset[2])
        dist = start_dist * (end_dist / start_dist) ** u          # exponential => constant perceived speed
        kfs[t] = orbit_kf(c, dist, y0 + yaw_drift * u, _lerp(start_pitch, end_pitch, u))
    return Shot(name or f"drone_pullup@{start}", "drone_pullup", start, ticks[-1], [Track("CAMERA_ORBIT", kfs)],
                "rising reveal", dict(start_dist=start_dist, end_dist=end_dist))

            pitch: float = 8.0, angle: float | None = None, angle_offset: float = 155.0,
            fov_from: float | None = None, fov_to: float | None = None, center_offset=(0.0, 1.3, 0.0),
            ease: str = "inout", samples_per_s: float = 4.0, name: str | None = None) -> Shot:

    ``target_yaw + angle_offset`` (155 = front 3/4 view). Optional FOV ramp (dolly-zoom: fov_from>fov_to)."""

    yaw = (tg.rot(start)[0] + angle_offset) if angle is None else angle
    n = len(ticks) - 1
    kfs = {}
    for i, t in enumerate(ticks):
        u = e(i / n)
        px, py, pz = tg.pos(t)
        c = (px + center_offset[0], py + center_offset[1], pz + center_offset[2])
        kfs[t] = orbit_kf(c, _lerp(start_dist, end_dist, u), yaw, pitch)
    tracks = [Track("CAMERA_ORBIT", kfs)]

def flyby(target, start: int, seconds: float = 4.0, side: float = 8.0, height: float = 3.0, ahead: float = 16.0,
          side_sign: int = 1, look_offset=(0.0, 1.2, 0.0), ease: str = "inout", samples_per_s: float = 5.0,
          name: str | None = None) -> Shot:
    """Camera flies in a straight line past the target (abreast of it at mid-shot), always looking at it.
    One CAMERA track (positions computed by us, yaw/pitch aim at the target each sample)."""
    tg = as_target(target)
    ticks, total = _ticks(start, seconds, samples_per_s)
    mid = (ticks[0] + ticks[-1]) // 2
    # heading from the target's motion around mid-shot (fallback: its facing)
    a, b = tg.pos(max(0, mid - 10)), tg.pos(mid + 10)
    hx, hz = b[0] - a[0], b[2] - a[2]
    if math.hypot(hx, hz) < 0.5:
        yaw = math.radians(tg.rot(mid)[0])
        hx, hz = -math.sin(yaw), math.cos(yaw)
    hl = math.hypot(hx, hz)
    fx, fz = hx / hl, hz / hl                      # forward
    rx, rz = -fz, fx                               # right-hand lateral (x right, z down viewed from above: rotate)
    pm = tg.pos(mid)
    A = (pm[0] + side_sign * side * rx - ahead * fx, pm[1] + height, pm[2] + side_sign * side * rz - ahead * fz)
    B = (pm[0] + side_sign * side * rx + ahead * fx, pm[1] + height, pm[2] + side_sign * side * rz + ahead * fz)
    e = _ease(ease)
    n = len(ticks) - 1
    kfs = {}
    prev_yaw = None
    for i, t in enumerate(ticks):
        u = e(i / n)
        eye = tuple(_lerp(A[k], B[k], u) for k in range(3))
        px, py, pz = tg.pos(t)
        look = (px + look_offset[0], py + look_offset[1], pz + look_offset[2])
        yw = _yaw_to(eye, look)
        if prev_yaw is not None:
            yw = _unwrap(prev_yaw, yw)
        prev_yaw = yw
        kfs[t] = camera_eye_kf(eye, yw, _pitch_to(eye, look))
    return Shot(name or f"flyby@{start}", "flyby", start, ticks[-1], [Track("CAMERA", kfs)],
                "straight fly-by", dict(side=side, height=height, ahead=ahead))

def timelapse(target, start: int, end: int, video_seconds: float = 6.0, camera: str = "orbit",
              radius: float = 18.0, height: float = 9.0, revolutions: float = 0.5, name: str | None = None,
              pos=None) -> Shot:
    """Speed-up a long stretch (``end-start`` replay ticks) into ``video_seconds`` of video.

    Track layout: TIMELAPSE keyframes at timeline ticks (start, end) with video ticks (0, video_seconds*20) plus
    a camera track (``orbit`` around the target / ``static`` at ``pos`` looking at the target / ``follow``).
    Camera keyframes are placed in *timeline* ticks, evenly in real time (we convert through the linear
    timelapse mapping) so the orbit finishes exactly when the video does."""
    tg = as_target(target)
    vt = max(2, int(round(video_seconds * 20)))
    span = end - start
    n = max(4, int(math.ceil(video_seconds * 4)))
    to_tl = lambda i: start + int(round(i * span / n))
    kfs = {}
    e = _ease("inout" if camera == "orbit" else "linear")
    y0 = tg.rot(start)[0]
    for i in range(n + 1):
        t = to_tl(i)
        px, py, pz = tg.pos(t)
        c = (px, py + 1.2, pz)
        if camera == "orbit":
            kfs[t] = orbit_kf(c, math.hypot(radius, height), y0 + 360 * revolutions * e(i / n),
                              math.degrees(math.atan2(height, radius)))
        else:
            eye = pos or (px + radius, py + height, pz + radius)

    cam_type = "CAMERA_ORBIT" if camera == "orbit" else "CAMERA"
    tl = {start: timelapse_kf(0), end: timelapse_kf(vt)}
    return Shot(name or f"timelapse@{start}", "timelapse", start, end, [Track("TIMELAPSE", tl), Track(cam_type, kfs)],

def auto_shots(replay, max_shots: int = 8, seconds_scale: float = 1.0, lead_s: float = 1.0) -> list[Shot]:
    """Turn ``replay.suggest_moments()`` into Shot objects around the recording player."""
    from .flashback_replay import Replay  # local import to keep modules decoupled

    assert isinstance(replay, Replay)
    tg = as_target(replay.player_track(), replay.local_uuid)
    shots: list[Shot] = []

toolUseResult.stdout:
except OSError:
            return None

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- cinematic interface
    @staticmethod
    def _replay_uuid(replay: Path) -> str:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(replay) as z:
            return str(json.loads(z.read("metadata.json").decode("utf-8"))["uuid"])

    @staticmethod
    def _codec(name: str | None) -> str:
        return {"h264": "H264", "h265": "H265", "hevc": "H265", "av1": "AV1", "vp9": "VP9"}.get(str(name or "h264").lower(), "H264")

    def _shot_for_job(self, job: dict, scene: int) -> dict:
        ex = job["export"]
        rng = (job.get("camera", {}).get("keyframes") or {}).get("export_range_ticks") or [job.get("tick_start"), job.get("tick_end")]
        start, end = (rng + [None, None])[:2]
        vis = job.get("visuals", {})
        return {"scene": scene, "name": re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.@-]+", "_", job["job_id"] + "_" + str(job.get("shot_id", ""))),
                "start": start, "end": end, "output": str(Path(ex["output_abs"])), "width": int(ex["width"]),
                "height": int(ex["height"]), "fps": float(ex["fps"]), "container": "MP4", "codec": self._codec(ex.get("codec")),
                "encoder": None, "bitrate": int(ex.get("bitrate", 20_000_000)), "ssaa": False, "noGui": bool(vis.get("hide_gui", True)),
                "resetRng": False, "recordAudio": False, "transparent": False, "kind": job.get("kind", ""), "note": job["job_id"]}

    def render_batch(self, jobs: list[dict]) -> list[Result]:
        """Export several cinematic jobs of the SAME replay in one game launch (one scene per job)."""
        if not jobs:
            return []
        replays = {j["replay"]["path"] for j in jobs}
        if len(replays) != 1 or not next(iter(replays)):
            raise FlashbackAutoError("render_batch needs jobs that all reference the same replay path")
        replay = Path(replays.pop())
        project = jobs[0]["project"]
        run_dir = JOBS_DIR / project / f"run-{jobs[0]['job_id']}-x{len(jobs)}"
        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        # one editor state with one scene per job
        states, shots = [], []
        for i, j in enumerate(jobs):
            kf = (j.get("camera") or {}).get("keyframes")
            if not kf or kf.get("errors") or not kf.get("editor_state"):
                raise FlashbackAutoError(f"{j['job_id']}: no valid camera keyframes (editor_state) in the job; re-run queue "
                                         "with the replay available")
            states.append(kf["editor_state"])
            shots.append(self._shot_for_job(j, i))
        state = json.loads(json.dumps(states[0]))
        state["scenes"] = [st["scenes"][0] for st in states]
        state["sceneIndex"] = 0
        job_file = run_dir / "jobs.json"
        job_file.write_text(json.dumps({"version": 1, "replay": str(replay), "jobs": shots}, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        if not self.launch:
            return self.export(job_file, launch=False)

        from mcstudio import flashback_keyframes as FK
        errs = FK.validate_state(state)
        if errs:
            raise FlashbackAutoError("invalid editor state: " + "; ".join(errs[:3]))
        ed = self.mc_dir / "flashback" / "editor_states"
        target = ed / f"{self._replay_uuid(replay)}.json"
        backup = target.with_name(target.name + ".flashback_auto_backup")
        existed = target.exists()
        if existed and not backup.exists():
            shutil.copy2(target, backup)
        ed.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(FK.dumps_state(state), encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            return self.export(job_file, launch=True)
        finally:
            if existed:
                shutil.copy2(backup, target)       # put the creator's own editor state back
                backup.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            else:
                target.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    def render(self, job: dict) -> Path | None:
        """Exporter interface of mcstudio.cinematic: Path of the clip, None when it will arrive later (dry run), raises on failure."""
        out = Path(job["export"]["output_abs"])
        res = self.render_batch([job])[0]
        if res.ok:
            return out
        if res.message.startswith("dry run"):
            return None
        raise FlashbackAutoError(f"{job['job_id']}: {res.message}")

@dataclass
class Track:

    keyframes: dict[int, dict] = field(default_factory=dict)
    enabled: bool = True
    custom_name: str | None = None
    custom_colour: int = 0

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        d = {"keyframeType": self.type,
             "keyframesByTick": {str(k): v for k, v in sorted(self.keyframes.items())},
             "enabled": self.enabled}
        if self.custom_name:
            d["customName"] = self.custom_name
        d["customColour"] = self.custom_colour
        return d


@dataclass
class Shot:
    """One shot == one editor scene. ``start``/``end`` are replay ticks (export range)."""

    name: str
    kind: str
    start: int
    end: int
    tracks: list[Track]
    note: str = ""
    params: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def seconds(self) -> float:
        return (self.end - self.start) / 20.0

    def to_scene(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "keyframeTracks": [t.to_dict() for t in self.tracks],
            "exportStartTicks": int(self.start),
            "exportEndTicks": int(self.end),

def orbit(target, start: int, seconds: float = 6.0, radius: float = 6.0, height: float = 2.0,
          revolutions: float = 1.0, direction: int = 1, start_angle: float | None = None,
          center_offset=(0.0, 1.2, 0.0), ease: str = "inout", samples_per_s: float = 4.0,
          name: str | None = None) -> Shot:
    """Camera circles the (moving) target, always looking at it. One CAMERA_ORBIT track.

    radius = horizontal distance, height = camera height above the look-at point.
    ``start_angle`` = camera look yaw at the start (default: target's facing -> camera behind it).
    direction +1 = clockwise seen from above. Yaw is NOT wrapped (orbit interpolation is plain linear/CatmullRom
    on the number, so 360*n works)."""
    tg = as_target(target)
    ticks, total = _ticks(start, seconds, samples_per_s)
    e = _ease(ease)
    d = math.hypot(radius, height)
    pitch = math.degrees(math.atan2(height, radius))
    y0 = tg.rot(start)[0] if start_angle is None else start_angle
    kfs = {}
    n = len(ticks) - 1
    for i, t in enumerate(ticks):
        u = e(i / n)
        px, py, pz = tg.pos(t)
        c = (px + center_offset[0], py + center_offset[1], pz + center_offset[2])
        kfs[t] = orbit_kf(c, d, y0 + direction * 360.0 * revolutions * u, pitch)
    return Shot(name or f"orbit@{start}", "orbit", start, ticks[-1], [Track("CAMERA_ORBIT", kfs)],
                f"orbit r={radius} h={height} rev={revolutions}", dict(radius=radius, height=height))


def drone_pullup(target, start: int, seconds: float = 5.0, start_dist: float = 3.5, end_dist: float = 45.0,
                 start_pitch: float = 8.0, end_pitch: float = 68.0, yaw_drift: float = 35.0,
                 start_angle: float | None = None, center_offset=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), ease: str = "inout",
                 samples_per_s: float = 5.0, name: str | None = None) -> Shot:
    """Camera starts low and close behind the target and rises/backs away while tilting down (reveal shot)."""
    tg = as_target(target)
    ticks, total = _ticks(start, seconds, samples_per_s)
    e = _ease(ease)
    y0 = tg.rot(start)[0] if start_angle is None else start_angle
    n = len(ticks) - 1

    for i, t in enumerate(ticks):
        u = e(i / n)
        px, py, pz = tg.pos(t)
        c = (px + center_offset[0], py + center_offset[1], pz + center_offset[2])
        dist = start_dist * (end_dist / start_dist) ** u          # exponential => constant perceived speed
        kfs[t] = orbit_kf(c, dist, y0 + yaw_drift * u, _lerp(start_pitch, end_pitch, u))
    return Shot(name or f"drone_pullup@{start}", "drone_pullup", start, ticks[-1], [Track("CAMERA_ORBIT", kfs)],
                "rising reveal", dict(start_dist=start_dist, end_dist=end_dist))

"""rd-full v2 cinematics: purposeful Flashback shots designed against the locked cut (not templates).

    uv run python projects/rd-full/cinematic_v2.py --plan        # build + validate every shot, no game launch
    uv run python projects/rd-full/cinematic_v2.py --render      # launch Minecraft (once per replay) and export them

Every shot has a REASON (the moment in the video it elevates) and its own camera language:
  reveal      rising pull-back that shows the scale of something (diamond blocks in every chunk, the TNT field, the End island)
  timelapse   hundreds of seconds of mining compressed into ~9 s with an orbit (so the grind is actually sped up)
  slowmo      slowed game time with a camera move (creepers falling, explosions, the dragon taking a hit)
  chase       the camera rides with the player

Outputs: projects/rd-full/broll2/<name>.mp4 (16:9) and <name>_v.mp4 (9:16 for Shorts) + cin_plan2.json (what goes where).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STUDIO = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(STUDIO))

from mcstudio import flashback_keyframes as FK  # noqa: E402

FD = Path.home() / "AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/flashback/replays"

OFFSET = {1: 17.654, 2: 23.063, 3: 14.9}          # replay time at video t=0 (xcorr for 1-2, dimension-marker match for 3)

def tk(part: int, video_s: float) -> int:
    return int(round((video_s + OFFSET[part]) * 20))


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- shot builders
def add_track(shot: FK.Shot, track: FK.Track) -> FK.Shot:
    shot.tracks.append(track)
    return shot


def reveal(tg, tick, secs, d0=4.0, d1=90.0, p0=10.0, p1=70.0, fov0=70.0, fov1=100.0, drift=40.0, tod=None, name=""):
    s = FK.drone_pullup(tg, tick, secs, start_dist=d0, end_dist=d1, start_pitch=p0, end_pitch=p1, yaw_drift=drift, name=name)
    add_track(s, FK.Track("FOV", {s.start: FK.fov_kf(fov0), s.end: FK.fov_kf(fov1)}))
    if tod is not None:
        add_track(s, FK.Track("TIME_OF_DAY", {s.start: FK.time_of_day_kf(tod)}))
    s.kind = "reveal"
    return s


def slowmo_orbit(tg, tick, game_s, rate, radius=8.0, height=3.0, rev=0.5, shake=0.0, name=""):
    s = FK.orbit(tg, tick, game_s, radius=radius, height=height, revolutions=rev, samples_per_s=8.0, name=name)
    add_track(s, FK.Track("SPEED", {s.start: FK.tickrate_kf(rate), s.end: FK.tickrate_kf(rate)}))
    if shake:
        mid = (s.start + s.end) // 2
        add_track(s, FK.Track("CAMERA_SHAKE", {s.start: FK.shake_kf(0, 0, 0, 0), mid: FK.shake_kf(9, shake, 9, shake),
                                               s.end: FK.shake_kf(2, 0.2, 2, 0.2)}))
    s.kind = "slowmo"
    return s


def look_up_slowmo(tg, tick, game_s, rate, name=""):
    """Camera rides just behind the player and tilts up into the sky (things falling out of it)."""
    s = FK.track_follow(tg, tick, game_s, distance=2.6, up=0.5, part="HEAD", pitch_offset=-52.0, name=name)
    add_track(s, FK.Track("SPEED", {s.start: FK.tickrate_kf(rate), s.end: FK.tickrate_kf(rate)}))
    add_track(s, FK.Track("FOV", {s.start: FK.fov_kf(85.0), s.end: FK.fov_kf(100.0)}))
    s.kind = "slowmo"
    return s


def time_lapse(tg, t0, t1, video_s, radius=15.0, height=7.0, rev=1.0, name=""):
    s = FK.timelapse(tg, t0, t1, video_seconds=video_s, camera="orbit", radius=radius, height=height, revolutions=rev, name=name)
    s.kind = "timelapse"
    return s


def chase_slowmo(tg, tick, game_s, rate, dist=9.0, up=3.5, shake=1.2, name=""):
    s = FK.track_follow(tg, tick, game_s, distance=dist, up=up, part="BODY", pitch_offset=14.0, yaw_offset_end=35.0, name=name)
    mid = (s.start + s.end) // 2
    add_track(s, FK.Track("SPEED", {s.start: FK.tickrate_kf(rate), s.end: FK.tickrate_kf(rate)}))
    add_track(s, FK.Track("CAMERA_SHAKE", {s.start: FK.shake_kf(0, 0, 0, 0), mid: FK.shake_kf(10, shake, 10, shake),

    add("A_lightning", 1, lambda tg: reveal(tg, tk(1, 452.0), 8.0, d0=5, d1=70, p0=8, p1=48, fov0=75, fov1=95, tod=13200, name="A_lightning"),
        "the world is on fire and being struck by lightning: show the scale from above")
    add("B_every_chunk", 1, lambda tg: reveal(tg, tk(1, 1838.0), 9.0, d0=4, d1=130, p0=6, p1=82, fov0=70, fov1=105, drift=70, name="B_every_chunk"),
        "diamond blocks were placed in EVERY chunk: pull back until the whole grid of blocks is visible", vertical=True)
    add("C_go_ham", 1, lambda tg: time_lapse(tg, tk(1, 2615.0), tk(1, 2955.0), 9.0, radius=13, height=6, rev=1.0, name="C_go_ham"),
        "'cue the epic cinematic shot of me breaking all these blocks': ~6 minutes of mining compressed into 9 s")
    add("D_creepers_fall", 1, lambda tg: look_up_slowmo(tg, tk(1, 3176.0), 2.2, 6.0, name="D_creepers_fall"),
        "creepers and skeletons are literally falling from the sky: slow motion, camera looking up", vertical=True)
    add("E_spiders_boom", 1, lambda tg: slowmo_orbit(tg, tk(1, 3588.0), 2.0, 5.0, radius=7, height=3, rev=0.45, shake=1.0, name="E_spiders_boom"),

    add("G_rage_quit", 2, lambda tg: reveal(tg, tk(2, 4724.0) - 140, 7.0, d0=3, d1=45, p0=5, p1=62, fov0=70, fov1=88, drift=-50, name="G_rage_quit"),
        "he is surrounded and about to rage quit: the camera pulls away and leaves him alone")
    # ---- part 3
    add("H_the_end", 3, lambda tg: reveal(tg, tk(3, 1692.0), 9.0, d0=6, d1=85, p0=4, p1=34, fov0=80, fov1=105, drift=55, name="H_the_end"),

    add("J_tnt_field", 3, lambda tg: reveal(tg, tk(3, 3976.0), 8.0, d0=4, d1=100, p0=8, p1=75, fov0=70, fov1=105, drift=60, name="J_tnt_field"),

    add("K_tnt_mining", 3, lambda tg: time_lapse(tg, tk(3, 4043.0), tk(3, 4368.0), 10.0, radius=17, height=8, rev=1.0, name="K_tnt_mining"),
        "500 blocks of TNT mined under the dragon: the grind sped up for real", vertical=True)
    add("L_explosion", 3, lambda tg: chase_slowmo(tg, tk(3, 4760.0), 2.2, 6.0, dist=11, up=4.0, shake=1.4, name="L_explosion"),

               "export": {"width": 1080 if vertical else 1920, "height": 1920 if vertical else 1080, "fps": 30, "codec": "h264",
                          "output": str(out), "output_abs": str(out)}}
        jobs.append(job)

    return jobs, meta


def main():

        print(f"      {m['why']}")

"""YouTube Shorts as SUPER-CUT edits (not clips of the long video).

    uv run python projects/rd-full/shorts_cut.py            -> projects/rd-cut-1..5 (vertical edit.json) and renders them

How these differ from `mcs shorts`:
  * beats are picked by WORDS from the transcript (start phrase .. end phrase), reordered hook-first (payoff, then the story)
  * every beat is tightened: any pause > 0.35 s is cut, each cut gets a punch-in / pull-out so something moves every ~2 s
  * 2-6 s of the long video's context is dropped; only the funniest/most legible lines survive
  * rapid SFX hits on cuts, meme/green-screen payoffs, death montages, TNT wall, Flashback shots (vertical versions)
  * its own energetic music (drop on the first frame), captions big and high, hook banner for the first 2.4 s
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STUDIO = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(STUDIO))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from mcstudio import assets as A  # noqa: E402
from mcstudio.edl import seg_duration  # noqa: E402
import music_plan3 as MP  # noqa: E402

OFF = {1: 0.0, 2: 3922.048, 3: 3922.048 + 4780.842}
PAD_LEAD, PAD_TAIL, GAP = 0.10, 0.30, 0.36      # tight: pause > GAP is cut; padding is small but never clips words
SIGNALS = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "signals.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ORIG = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "transcript.orig.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
WORDS = [w for s in ORIG["segments"] for w in s.get("words", [])]
TOK = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9']", "", w["word"].lower()) for w in WORDS]
FLAGS = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "flags.json").read_text())
import bisect  # noqa: E402


def T(part, ts):
    m, s = ts.split(":")
    return OFF[part] + int(m) * 60 + float(s)


def find(phrase, hint, after=None, within=45.0):
    """index range of the phrase nearest to `hint` (absolute s) in WORDS, optionally starting after word index `after`"""
    ph = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9']", "", p.lower()) for p in phrase]
    best = None
    lo = (after or 0)
    for i in range(lo, len(WORDS) - len(ph) + 1):
        if abs(WORDS[i]["start"] - hint) > within:
            continue
        if TOK[i:i + len(ph)] == ph:
            d = abs(WORDS[i]["start"] - hint)
            if best is None or d < best[0]:
                best = (d, i, i + len(ph) - 1)
    return best[1:] if best else None


def tight(i0, i1):
    """[(start, end)] cut at pauses, padded - the words from i0..i1 only"""
    ws = WORDS[i0:i1 + 1]
    out = []
    for w in ws:
        a, b = w["start"] - PAD_LEAD, w["end"] + PAD_TAIL
        if out and w["start"] - WORDS[WORDS.index(w) - 1]["end"] <= GAP:
            out[-1][1] = b
        else:
            out.append([a, b])
    return [(round(a, 3), round(b, 3)) for a, b in out if b - a > 0.35]


def ok_frames(a, b):
    t = FLAGS["t"]
    i, j = bisect.bisect_left(t, a), bisect.bisect_right(t, b)
    return all(FLAGS["flag"][k] in ("ok", "gui", "death") for k in range(i, max(i + 1, j)))


class Short:
    def __init__(self, n, hook, music, drop=True):
        self.n, self.hook, self.music = n, hook, music
        self.segs, self.sfx, self.ovl, self.text = [], [], [], []
        self.k = 0
        self.music_role = "drop" if drop else "start"

    def sid(self, p="s"):
        self.k += 1
        return f"{p}{self.k:03d}"

    def add_src(self, a, b, speed=1.0, zoom=True, extra=None, exact=False, mute_mic=False, game_db=None):
        s = {"id": self.sid(), "type": "source", "in": round(a, 3), "out": round(b, 3), "frame_x": 0.5}
        if speed != 1.0:
            s["speed"] = speed
        if exact:
            s["exact"] = True
        if mute_mic:
            s["mute_mic"] = True
        if game_db is not None:
            s["game_db"] = game_db
        if zoom:                                    # alternate punch-in / wide so every cut has motion
            tgt = 1.28 if (len(self.segs) % 2 == 0) else 1.14
            s["zoom"] = [{"src_at": round(a + 0.04, 3), "to": tgt, "in": 0.12, "hold": max(0.2, b - a - 0.25), "out": 0.1,
                          "focus": [0.5, 0.5]}]
        if extra:
            s.update(extra)
        self.segs.append(s)
        return s

    def phrase(self, phrase, hint, to=None, after=None, **kw):
        """add the words `phrase` .. `to` (or just the phrase) as tight sub-cuts; returns the last segment or None"""
        r = find(phrase, hint, after)
        if not r:
            print(f"   [short {self.n}] phrase not found: {' '.join(phrase)}")
            return None
        i0, i1 = r
        if to:
            r2 = find(to, WORDS[i1]["start"], after=i0, within=25.0)
            if r2:
                i1 = r2[1]
        last = None
        rs = tight(i0, i1)
        for a, b in rs:
            last = self.add_src(a, b, **kw)
        if last and len(self.segs) > 1:
            self.sfx.append({"asset": "sfx_meme.camera-whoosh-01", "seg": self.segs[-len(rs)]["id"], "rel": 0.0, "dur": 0.5,
                             "volume_db": -9})
        return last

    def meme(self, asset, secs=1.6):
        a = A.get(asset)
        lo = a.get("use_in") or 0.0
        hi = min(a.get("use_out") or a["duration_s"], lo + secs)
        self.segs.append({"id": self.sid("m"), "type": "cutaway", "asset": asset, "in": round(lo, 2), "out": round(hi, 2)})

    def sfx_at(self, asset, seg, rel=0.0, vol=-2, dur=None):
        e = {"asset": asset, "seg": seg["id"], "rel": rel, "volume_db": vol}
        if dur:
            e["dur"] = dur
        self.sfx.append(e)

    def label(self, text, seg, dur=1.2, style="minecraft", y=0.2, size=86):
        self.text.append({"text": text, "seg": seg["id"], "rel": 0.05, "dur": dur, "style": style, "x": 0.5, "y": y, "size": size})

    def freeze_gs(self, asset, src_in, dur, at_seg, freeze=3.2, scale=0.95):
        """freeze the last frame of at_seg, strip the colour, pop a green screen over it"""
        i = self.segs.index(at_seg)
        frz = {"id": self.sid("f"), "type": "source", "in": round(at_seg["out"] - 0.1, 3), "out": round(at_seg["out"], 3), "exact": True,
               "effects": ["bw"], "freeze_end": freeze, "mute_mic": True, "game_db": -10, "frame_x": 0.5}
        self.segs.insert(i + 1, frz)
        self.ovl.append({"type": "greenscreen", "asset": asset, "seg": frz["id"], "rel": 0.0, "x": 0.5, "y": 0.62, "scale": scale,
                         "dur": dur, "in": src_in})
        return frz

    def deaths(self, times, label=True, lead=0.9, tail=0.45):
        for n, td in enumerate(times, 1):
            a = td - lead
            while a < td - 0.25 and not ok_frames(a, td):
                a += 0.2
            s = self.add_src(a, td + tail, zoom=True, exact=True, mute_mic=True, game_db=0)
            if label:
                self.label(f"DEATH #{n}", s, dur=0.9, style="danger", y=0.16, size=96)

    def build(self, cin=None):
        total = sum(seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i)) for s in self.segs)
        segs = self.segs
        edl = {"version": 1, "project": f"rd-cut-{self.n}", "title": self.hook, "format": "vertical", "mode": "funny", "look": "none",
               "max_rating": "explicit", "generator": "rd-full shorts cut",
               "style": {"audio": {"mix": {"voice_chain": "highpass=f=70,acompressor=threshold=-22dB:ratio=3:attack=8:release=140:makeup=2,"
                                                          "acompressor=threshold=-13dB:ratio=4.5:attack=3:release=70,alimiter=limit=0.75:attack=3:release=40"}}},
               "segments": segs, "overlays": list(self.ovl), "text": list(self.text),
               "audio": {"sfx": list(self.sfx), "bleeps": [], "music": []},
               "captions": {"enabled": True, "emphasis_words": [], "hide": []}}
        # hook banner
        edl["overlays"].insert(0, {"type": "motion", "template": "hook_banner", "vars": {"text": self.hook}, "seg": segs[0]["id"],
                                   "rel": 0.0, "dur": 2.4})
        # music: drop on the first frame, same loudness plan as the long video (voice-forward, but punchy)
        t = MP.track(self.music)
        if t:
            off = MP.offset_for(t, self.music_role, total)
            edl["audio"]["music"].append({"file": t["path"], "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 2), "in": round(off, 2),
                                          "volume_db": MP.volume_for(t, "start", False) + 3.0, "fade_in": 0.15, "fade_out": 0.9,
                                          "duck": True})
        # bleeps (the audio keeps the real words)
        sw = re.compile(r"(fuck|nigg|dick|bitch|cunt|cock|pussy|whore|slut)", re.I)
        kept = [(s["in"], s["out"]) for s in segs if s["type"] == "source"]
        for w, tok in zip(WORDS, TOK):
            if sw.search(tok) and any(a - 0.05 <= w["start"] <= b for a, b in kept):
                edl["audio"]["bleeps"].append({"src_at": round(w["start"] - 0.03, 3), "dur": round(max(0.35, w["end"] - w["start"] + 0.15), 3)})
        return edl, total


def finish(sh: Short):

"""YouTube Shorts as SUPER-CUT edits (not clips of the long video).

    uv run python projects/rd-full/shorts_cut.py            -> projects/rd-cut-1..5 (vertical edit.json) and renders them

How these differ from `mcs shorts`:
  * beats are picked by WORDS from the transcript (start phrase .. end phrase), reordered hook-first (payoff, then the story)
  * every beat is tightened: any pause > 0.35 s is cut, each cut gets a punch-in / pull-out so something moves every ~2 s
  * 2-6 s of the long video's context is dropped; only the funniest/most legible lines survive
  * rapid SFX hits on cuts, meme/green-screen payoffs, death montages, TNT wall, Flashback shots (vertical versions)
  * its own energetic music (drop on the first frame), captions big and high, hook banner for the first 2.4 s
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STUDIO = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(STUDIO))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from mcstudio import assets as A  # noqa: E402
from mcstudio.edl import seg_duration  # noqa: E402
import music_plan3 as MP  # noqa: E402

OFF = {1: 0.0, 2: 3922.048, 3: 3922.048 + 4780.842}
PAD_LEAD, PAD_TAIL, GAP = 0.10, 0.30, 0.36      # tight: pause > GAP is cut; padding is small but never clips words
SIGNALS = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "signals.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ORIG = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "transcript.orig.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
WORDS = [w for s in ORIG["segments"] for w in s.get("words", [])]
TOK = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9']", "", w["word"].lower()) for w in WORDS]
FLAGS = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "flags.json").read_text())
import bisect  # noqa: E402


def T(part, ts):
    m, s = ts.split(":")
    return OFF[part] + int(m) * 60 + float(s)


def find(phrase, hint, after=None, within=45.0):
    """index range of the phrase nearest to `hint` (absolute s) in WORDS, optionally starting after word index `after`"""
    ph = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9']", "", p.lower()) for p in phrase]
    best = None
    lo = (after or 0)
    for i in range(lo, len(WORDS) - len(ph) + 1):
        if abs(WORDS[i]["start"] - hint) > within:
            continue
        if TOK[i:i + len(ph)] == ph:
            d = abs(WORDS[i]["start"] - hint)
            if best is None or d < best[0]:
                best = (d, i, i + len(ph) - 1)
    return best[1:] if best else None


def tight(i0, i1):
    """[(start, end)] cut at pauses, padded - the words from i0..i1 only"""
    ws = WORDS[i0:i1 + 1]
    out = []
    for w in ws:
        a, b = w["start"] - PAD_LEAD, w["end"] + PAD_TAIL
        if out and w["start"] - WORDS[WORDS.index(w) - 1]["end"] <= GAP:
            out[-1][1] = b
        else:
            out.append([a, b])
    return [(round(a, 3), round(b, 3)) for a, b in out if b - a > 0.35]


def ok_frames(a, b):
    t = FLAGS["t"]
    i, j = bisect.bisect_left(t, a), bisect.bisect_right(t, b)
    return all(FLAGS["flag"][k] in ("ok", "gui", "death") for k in range(i, max(i + 1, j)))


class Short:
    def __init__(self, n, hook, music, drop=True):
        self.n, self.hook, self.music = n, hook, music
        self.segs, self.sfx, self.ovl, self.text = [], [], [], []
        self.k = 0
        self.music_role = "drop" if drop else "start"

    def sid(self, p="s"):
        self.k += 1
        return f"{p}{self.k:03d}"

    def add_src(self, a, b, speed=1.0, zoom=True, extra=None, exact=False, mute_mic=False, game_db=None):
        s = {"id": self.sid(), "type": "source", "in": round(a, 3), "out": round(b, 3), "frame_x": 0.5}
        if speed != 1.0:
            s["speed"] = speed
        if exact:
            s["exact"] = True
        if mute_mic:
            s["mute_mic"] = True
        if game_db is not None:
            s["game_db"] = game_db
        if zoom:                                    # alternate punch-in / wide so every cut has motion
            tgt = 1.28 if (len(self.segs) % 2 == 0) else 1.14
            s["zoom"] = [{"src_at": round(a + 0.04, 3), "to": tgt, "in": 0.12, "hold": max(0.2, b - a - 0.25), "out": 0.1,
                          "focus": [0.5, 0.5]}]
        if extra:
            s.update(extra)
        self.segs.append(s)
        return s

    def phrase(self, phrase, hint, to=None, after=None, **kw):
        """add the words `phrase` .. `to` (or just the phrase) as tight sub-cuts; returns the last segment or None"""
        r = find(phrase, hint, after)
        if not r:
            print(f"   [short {self.n}] phrase not found: {' '.join(phrase)}")
            return None

               "segments": segs, "overlays": list(self.ovl), "text": list(self.text),
